meaning: n. 零售；零售业 v. 零售
example: Soon after Sketches by Bos appeared, a publishing firm approached Dickens to write a story in monthly installments, as a backdrop for a series of woodcuts by the then-famous artist Robert Seymour. (2017年Part B) 在『波兹』出版后不久，一家出版公司邀请狄更斯做一个每月连载，作为当时著名艺术家罗伯特·西摩的一系列版画的背景故事，也是西摩本人产生了这个故事的灵感。

meaning: a. 有影响力的 n. 有影响力的人物
example: In their recent work, however, some researchers have come up with the finding that influencers have far less impact on social epidemics. (2010年Text 3) 但是，一些研究者在他们最近的研究中发现，名人对于社会流行的影响力远不像一般人所认为的那样大。

meaning: a. 技术(性)的，工艺(上)的
example: In basketball, there's a foul known as a technical foul. 喜欢篮球的同学都知道篮球比赛中有一种犯规叫做 technical foul（技术犯规）。

meaning: n. 声称；所有权；索赔；主张 v. 声称；主张；要求；索取
example: Next time you state your position, formulate an argument for what you claim and honestly ask yourself whether your argument is any good. (2019年Part B) 下一次陈述你的立场时，为自己的主张形成一个论点，并且诚实地问问自己这个论点是否真的很好。

meaning: n. 肩 v. 承担；用肩膀推(挤)
example: He shouldered the responsibility for the mistake and promised to make things right. 他承担了这个错误的责任，并承诺要把事情做好。

meaning: a. 职业的；内行的；职业性的 n. 专业人士；专门职业者
example: She is a professional dancer who has performed on stages around the world. 她是一名职业舞蹈演员，曾在世界各地的舞台上表演。

meaning: vt. 允许；同意；给予；授予 n. 补助金，助学金
example: Over the past decade, thousands of patents have been granted for what are called business methods. (2010年Text 2) 在过去的十年里，成千上万所谓的商业方法专利获得批准。

meaning: n. 抱负；渴望得到的东西；追求的目标；夙愿
example: His lifelong ambition is to climb the highest mountain on every continent. 他毕生的抱负是攀登每一个大洲上的最高峰。

meaning: n. 尊敬；考虑；细节；方面 vt. 对…表示尊敬；仔细考虑
example: In limited respects, perhaps the recession will leave society better off. (2012年Text 4) 在个别方面，这次萧条可能也会使社会有所好转。

meaning: vt. 预言；预告；预见
example: It is likely that this rain will happen timely. 可能这场雨会准时来到。

meaning: ad. 高度地；高水平地；非常；极
example: She is highly regarded for her contributions to medical research. 她因对医学研究的贡献而备受推崇。

meaning: n. 结果；后果；逻辑上的必然结果
example: The consequence of his careless decision was the loss of his job. 他粗心大意的决定的后果是失去了工作。

meaning: n. 管理；经营；处理；管理部门，管理人员
example: The management of the company has decided to launch a new product line next spring. 公司的管理层决定在明年春天推出一条新的产品线。

meaning: vt. 保持；维持；保养；维护；主张；赡养；负担
example: To deliver results to its users quickly, then, Google has to maintain vast data centres round the world, packed with powerful computers. (2011年英语二Part B) 为了把搜索结果迅速传输给用户，谷歌不得不在全世界范围内建立大型数据中心，并配备大功率计算机。

meaning: a. 负有责任的，需承担责任的；责任重大的，重要的
example: Each team member is responsible for completing their part of the project on time. 每个团队成员都有责任按时完成自己的那部分工作。

meaning: n. 原则；原理；为人之道；道德，准则；操守；规范
example: In principle, every citizen should have equal access to education and healthcare. 原则上，每个公民都应该享有平等的受教育和医疗保健的权利。

meaning: n. 新闻工作者；新闻记者
example: She works as a journalist for a major international newspaper. 她是一家国际大报的新闻记者。

meaning: n. 变换位置 v. (汽车)换挡；n. 更换；轮班
example: As for me, weighing myself every day caused me to shift my focus from being generally healthy and physically active to focusing solely on the scale. (2019年英语二Use of English) 对我来说，每天称体重使我的注意力从保持健康和好动转移到仅仅关注于体重秤。

meaning: n. 变化；多样化；种类
example: To be sure, he performs an impressive variety of interesting compositions, but it is not necessary for me to visit Avery Fisher Hall, or anywhere else, to hear interesting orchestral music. (2011年Text 1) 诚然，他谱了很多给人留下深刻印象的有趣的曲子，但我没必要非要去曼维尔·费雪音乐厅或其他地方去欣赏有趣的管弦乐。

meaning: a. 国际的；世界的 n. 国际组织；国际体育比赛
example: The company has expanded its international operations to over thirty countries. 该公司已将其国际业务扩展到三十多个国家。

meaning: vt. 讲述；叙述；把…联系起来 vi. 涉及；认同
example: Many readers can relate to the main character's struggle to find his place in the world. 许多读者能够对主角寻找自己在世界中位置的挣扎产生共鸣。

meaning: n. 容量；最大限度；生产能力；智能；接受能力
example: Helping forests flourish as valuable carbon sinks long into the future may require reducing their capacity to absorb carbon now. (2019年英语二Text 2) 使森林在未来作为有价值的『碳汇』长期兴旺繁茂，这或许需要减少森林现在吸收碳的能力。

meaning: n. (动植物的)进化；进化论；演变；发展
example: He argued that human evolution was characterized by a struggle he called the survival of the fittest. (2009年Part B) 他认为人类进化的特点是竞争，他将其称为『适者生存』。

meaning: a. 工业的；产业的；工业工人的；工业发达的；工业用的
example: The industrial revolution transformed society in ways that still shape our lives today. 工业革命以多种方式改变了社会，这些方式仍在影响着我们的生活。

meaning: n. 期刊；杂志
example: Copyright rested with the journal publisher, and researchers seeking knowledge of the results would have to subscribe to the journal. (2008年Text 2) 版权归期刊出版商所有，而那些想了解研究成果的研究者不得不订阅该期刊。

meaning: n. 挑战；邀请赛；质疑；艰巨的任务 vt. 向…挑战；对…质疑；激发
example: The challenge of coping with automation underlines the need for the U.S. to revive its fading business dynamism: starting new companies must be made easier. (2018年Text 1) 应对机械化出现的挑战凸显了美国找回不断衰退的商业活力的必要性：简化创办新公司的流程。

meaning: vt. 计划；打算；想要
example: I intend to study abroad for my master's degree starting next fall. 我打算从明年秋天开始出国攻读硕士学位。

meaning: n. 倾向；趋势；趋向；动向；时尚；时髦 vi. 倾向；趋向
example: The trend toward remote work has reshaped how companies think about office space. 远程办公的趋势已经改变了公司对办公空间的看法。

meaning: n. 社会；社区；界；社会，公众
example: The local community quickly organized to help families affected by the flood. 当地社区迅速组织起来帮助受洪水影响的家庭。

meaning: n./a. 专家(的)；内行(的)；经验(知识)丰富的(人)
example: She is an expert in artificial intelligence and has published over fifty research papers. 她是人工智能领域的专家，已经发表了五十多篇研究论文。

meaning: a. 潜在的，有可能的 n. 潜力；潜能；可能性
example: The potential of this work applied to healthcare is very great, but it could also lead to further concentration of power in the tech giants. (2018年Text 3) 将人工智能应用于医疗保健领域这项工作的潜力是巨大的，但也可能导致权力会进一步集中到科技巨头们手中。

meaning: n. 真实；实在；真实的事物
example: In reality, the situation is far more complicated than the report suggests. 事实上，情况远比报告所暗示的要复杂得多。

meaning: ad. 大量地；主要地；在很大程度上
example: His success is largely due to years of patient practice and careful planning. 他的成功在很大程度上归功于多年耐心的练习和精心的规划。

meaning: a. 特殊的；特有的；(过于)挑剔的 n. 项目；详情；细节
example: I have a particular interest in how language shapes our perception of the world. 我对语言如何塑造我们对世界的感知有特别的兴趣。

meaning: a. 执行的；行政的；有行政能力的 n. 主管；高级行政人员；行政部门
example: As the chief executive of the company, she is responsible for setting its long-term strategy. 作为公司的首席执行官，她负责制定公司的长期战略。

meaning: n. 组织；机构；团体
example: The Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) has just issued a report describing the far-reaching consequences of this. (2008年Text 2) 世界经济合作与发展组织刚刚发布了一个报告，描述其深远意义。

meaning: v. (使)结合；联合；(使)化合；兼备，兼有
example: In previous eras of drastic technological change, entrepreneurs smoothed the transition by dreaming up ways to combine labor and machines. (2018年Text 1) 在过去急剧技术变革的时代，企业家们通过构思融合人工劳动和机器作业的方法促进了此次过渡。

meaning: n. 必需品；要求之物；要求；必要条件
example: Meeting the basic requirements is the first step before applying for the scholarship. 满足基本要求是申请奖学金之前的第一步。

meaning: n. (自外国移入的)移民
example: Many immigrants come to this country seeking better opportunities for themselves and their families. 许多移民来到这个国家，为自己和家人寻找更好的机会。

meaning: n. 焦虑；压力；重要性；重音 vt. 强调；发重音；使紧张；使受压力
example: Such bodily reaction might conceivably help moderate the effects of psychological stress. (2011年Use of English) 这种身体的反应或许可以设想的那样可以帮助缓解心理压力带来的影响。

meaning: n. 靠近；接近；临近；方法或态度 vt. 接近；找…商洽
example: We need a completely new approach if we want to solve this stubborn problem. 如果我们想解决这个棘手的问题，我们需要一个全新的方法。

meaning: a. 法律的；合法的；法定的 n. 法定权利；依法必须登报的声明
example: It is illegal for drivers who drink more than the legal limit of alcohol to drive. 血液中酒精含量超过法定限度的司机驾驶是违法的。/ Drivers who exceed the legal blood-alcohol limit are breaking the law. 血液中酒精含量超过法定限度的司机驾驶是违法的。

meaning: n. 机会；有利的条件
example: In other words, at a time when the working class has turned the country on its political head, frustrated that the opportunity that once defined America is vanishing, one obvious solution is staring us in the face. (2018年英语二Text 1) 换句话说，美国曾经最大的特点就是机会遍地，而现在这些机会正在消失，工薪阶层因此受困，所以将矛头对准了国家领导人，在这样一个时刻，解决方案迫在眉睫。

meaning: n. 癌症；恶性肿瘤；弊病；社会恶习
example: Years of research have led to new treatments that give cancer patients a much better chance of recovery. 多年的研究带来了新的治疗方法，使癌症患者有更大的康复机会。

meaning: a. 联邦的；同盟的
example: In effect, fewer federal funds today are going towards the agency's other work—such as forest conservation, watershed and cultural resources management, and infrastructure upkeep—that affect the lives of all Americans. (2017年英语二Text 4) 实际上，目前较少的联邦资金会用在林业局的其他项目上，如森林保护、流域文化资源管理和基础设施维护，而这些都会影响到美国人的生活。

meaning: n. 事实；事件；情况；环境；条件；仪式
example: Under the circumstances, we have no choice but to postpone the meeting until next week. 在这种情况下，我们别无选择，只能把会议推迟到下周。

meaning: a. 基本的；必要的；本质的；精华的 n. 必需品；要素；精髓
example: Water is essential for the survival of every living organism on the planet. 水是地球上所有生物生存所必需的。

meaning: n. 智力；情报；消息
example: This girl has exceptional intelligence compared with ordinary girls. 这个女孩比起普通女孩来智商非凡。

meaning: a. 智力的；有才智的 n. 知识分子；脑力劳动者
example: These days, because leisure time is relatively scarce for most workers, people use their free time to counterbalance the intellectual and emotional demands of their jobs. (2017年英语二Use of English) 如今，因为大多数工人的闲暇时间相对稀缺，人们利用自由时间来平衡他们工作的智力和情绪需求。

meaning: a. 经济的；经济学的；合算的；有经济效益的
example: The government has introduced new policies aimed at strengthening long-term economic growth. 政府已经推出了旨在加强长期经济增长的新政策。

meaning: n. 下降；衰退 vi. 下降；下倾；谢绝 vt. 倾斜；婉拒
example: The star declined to comment on the gossip and walked past the reporters quickly. 那位明星拒绝评论这则绯闻，并快步走过记者身边。

meaning: a. 可用的；能得到的；空闲的；有效的
example: These recordings are cheap, available everywhere, and very often much higher in artistic quality than today's live performances. (2011年Text 1) 这些唱片便宜、随处可见，而且比起如今的现场表演，艺术性通常更高。

meaning: n. 账；账目；存款；记述；报告；描述 vi. 解释；导致；报账
example: By all accounts he was a freethinking person, and a courageous one, and I find courage an essential quality for the understanding, let alone the performance, of his works. (2014年Part C) 据大家所说，贝多芬是个思想自由且勇气可嘉的人，我发现勇气是理解其作品的关键因素，更是演奏其佳作的必要条件。

meaning: n. 竞争；比赛
example: Fierce competition among tech companies has driven rapid innovation in recent years. 近年来，科技公司之间的激烈竞争推动了快速的创新。

meaning: a. 明显的；显著的；平淡无奇的
example: It is obvious from her expression that she has heard the good news already. 从她的表情来看，她显然已经听到了这个好消息。

meaning: n. 物质；材料；主旨；要点；实质；内容；真实性
example: We need to grasp the substance of the issue rather than getting lost in minor details. 我们需要把握问题的实质，而不是迷失在细枝末节中。

meaning: n. 压力；挤压；压；压迫感 vt. 强迫；使迫不得已
example: Today, widespread social pressure to immediately go to college in conjunction with increasing high expectations in a fast-moving world often cause students to completely overlook the possibility of taking a gap year. (2017年英语二Text 3) 如今，由于社会上普遍存在要尽快上大学的压力，以及在快速发展的世界中越来越高的期望，学生完全忽视了一年间隔年的可能性。

meaning: n. 生产率；生产力；生产效率
example: The new software has significantly boosted the productivity of the entire team. 新软件显著提高了整个团队的生产效率。

meaning: a. 可能的；看来要…的 ad. 很可能
example: She is likely to win the competition if she keeps up her current level of training. 如果她保持目前的训练水平，她很可能会赢得比赛。

meaning: n. 病人 a. 有耐心的
example: The doctor reminded the patient to take the medicine on time every day. 医生提醒病人每天按时服药。

meaning: vt. 强调；着重
example: The report emphasizes the need for stronger environmental protection policies. 该报告强调需要更强有力的环保政策。

meaning: v. 出现，浮现；暴露，摆脱
example: As this new science of habit has emerged, controversies have erupted when the tactics have been used to sell questionable beauty creams or unhealthy foods. (2010年Text 3) 随着这一新的习惯科学的出现，争议已经产生，比如这些策略已被用于销售有问题的美容霜和不健康的产品。

meaning: n. 安全(感)；保护(物)；保证，抵押；证券，债券
example: Can privacy be preserved while bringing safety and security to a world that seems increasingly lawless? (2011年Use of English) 在这个世界似乎越来越无法无天之时，隐私能否在带来安全和保障的同时得到保护？

meaning: n. 偏见，偏向，趋势；对角方向；斜纹 a. 斜的 vi. 使…持有偏见
example: Unconscious bias can affect hiring decisions even when managers try to be fair. 即使管理者试图做到公平，无意识的偏见也会影响招聘决定。

meaning: n. 交易，合同交易，协议；特价商品，便宜的东西 vi. 讨价还价
example: She managed to bargain the price down to half of what was originally asked. 她设法把价格砍到了原来要价的一半。

meaning: v. 证明，识别，鉴定；发现，承认
example: Rats and other animals need to be highly attuned to social signals from others so they can identify friends to cooperate with and enemies to avoid. (2020年Text 1) 老鼠和其他动物需要高度适应来自其他动物的社交信号，这样它们才能识别出要合作的朋友和要躲避的敌人。

meaning: n. 期待；预期的事物
example: The result fell short of our initial expectations, so we need to revise our plan. 结果没有达到我们最初的预期，所以我们需要修改计划。

meaning: a. 起初的，原来的；独创的，新颖的；原版的，原件的 n. 原件，原作
example: By the third generation, the original language is lost in the majority of immigrant families. (2006年Text 1) 到了第三代移民的时候，原来的语言在大多数移民家庭中丧失。

meaning: vt. 拥护，主张 n. 拥护者，提倡者；辩护者；律师
example: Even Tommasini, who had advocated Gilbert's appointment in the Times, calls him an unpretentious musician with no air of the formidable conductor about him. (2011年Text 1) 甚至是《泰晤士报》上发文支持用吉尔伯特担任比昂思奇职务的乐评家，在他身上也找不到那种飞扬跋扈的指挥家的气质。

meaning: ad. 最后，最终
example: After several failed attempts, he eventually managed to pass the driving test. 经过几次失败的尝试，他最终通过了驾驶考试。

meaning: n. 物种；种类
example: Many species are at risk of extinction because of climate change and habitat loss. 由于气候变化和栖息地的丧失，许多物种正面临灭绝的危险。

meaning: a. 稳定的；稳健的；不易分解或起化学反应的
example: His analysis should therefore end any self-contentedness among those who may believe that the global position of English is so stable that the young generation of the United Kingdom do not need additional language capabilities. (2017年Part C) 他的分析应消除一些人认为英语的国际地位如此稳固以至于英国的年轻一代不需要额外语言能力的那种自满心理。

meaning: n. 专家；专科医生
example: She is a heart specialist with twenty years of clinical experience. 她是一名心脏专科医生，拥有二十年的临床经验。

meaning: n. 利益，益处，好处；救济金；保险金 vt. 有益于 vi. 得益
example: But because hard laughter is difficult to sustain, a good laugh is unlikely to have measurable benefits the way, say, walking or jogging does. (2011年Use of English) 但是因为大笑很难保持，所以不可能用衡量散步或慢跑好处的方式来衡量大笑带来的好处。

meaning: n. 活动；活动力；行动；活跃，敏捷
example: Outdoor activities such as hiking are great for both physical and mental health. 远足等户外活动对身心健康都很有益。

meaning: vt. 拒绝（接受）；因无用或不好而丢弃
example: If we know female job screeners are more likely to reject attractive female applicants, we can help screeners understand their biases—or hire outside screeners. (2013年英语二Text 3) 如果我们知道女安检员更有可能拒绝理解其偏见的女性申请人，我们可以帮助安检人员了解他们的偏见或者聘请外部安检员。

meaning: n. 特性，属性；财产，地产
example: The price of property in the city center has skyrocketed over the past decade. 过去十年，市中心的房地产价格飞涨。

meaning: vt. 观察到，察觉；遵守；保持
example: The behavioral sciences have been slow to change partly because the explanatory items often seem to be directly observed and partly because other kinds of explanations have been hard to find. (2002年Part C) 行为科学发展一直很缓慢，部分原因是很难找到对行为解释的依赖性，也往往直接观察到。

meaning: vi. 幸存，存活；vt. 比…活得长，经历…之后还活下来
example: Only a few passengers survived the plane crash in the remote mountain area. 在偏远的山区，只有几名乘客在飞机失事中幸存下来。

meaning: n. 代理人，代理商；(使某事发生的)施动者，动因
example: Instead, the best strategy is to use the agent as a kind of tip service to keep abreast of jobs in a particular database. (2004年Text 1) 实际上，最佳策略是把代理人当作一种提示性服务，来及时跟踪一个特定数据库里的工作信息。

meaning: n. 机构，团体；惯例，习俗，制度
example: For public institutions, state funds are tied partly to their success on metrics such as graduation rates and student retention—so better grades can, by boosting figures like those, mean more money. (2019年Text 2) 对于大学来讲，国家的基金有时候是根据一些因素来判定的，比如毕业率和学生保留率，因此好的分数意味着钱。

meaning: n. 辩论，辩论会；争论 vt. 考虑；讨论；盘算
example: Scholars, policymakers, and critics of all stripes have debated the social implications of these changes, but few have looked at the side effect: family risk has risen as well. (2007年Text 3) 各行各业的学者、政策制定者和批评家都就这些变化的社会意义展开辩论，但是很少有人看到其副作用：家庭风险也提高了。

meaning: a. 明确的；特有的；具体的 n. 特效药；具体方面，细节
example: There are a number of approaches to mastering the art of deep work—he will length retreats dedicated to a specific task; developing a daily ritual; or taking a journalistic approach to seizing a daily ritual or taking a journalistic throughout the day. (2018年英语二Text 4) 掌握深入工作的方法有很多种：为特定任务而进行的较长时段的休息；形成一种日常仪式；或者采取『纪实式』的方法在一日当中可能抓紧一天深入工作的时机。

meaning: a. 宗教的；笃信宗教的
example: The village has a long religious tradition that goes back several centuries. 这个村庄有着数百年之久的悠久宗教传统。

meaning: a. 批评的，批判的；紧要关头的；决定性的；评判性的
example: The patient is now in critical condition and needs immediate medical attention. 病人目前情况危急，需要立即进行医疗处理。

meaning: vt. 原谅，宽恕；为…辩解的理由，免除 n. 理由，借口，辩解
example: She tried to excuse her late arrival by blaming the heavy traffic, but no one believed her. 她试图以交通拥堵为借口来为迟到辩解，但没人相信她。

meaning: n. 批评，批判；指责；评论，评论文
example: The new policy has drawn strong criticism from both opposition parties and the public. 新政策遭到了反对党和公众的强烈批评。

meaning: n. 地位，身份，情况；重要性
example: They have no wish for any change in the status quo. 他们不想改变现状。

meaning: vt. 解释，给…下定义；限定，使明确；标明…的界限
example: In other words, at a time when the working class has turned the country on its political head, frustrated that the opportunity that once defined America is vanishing, one obvious solution is staring us in the face. (2018年英语二Text 1) 换句话说，美国曾经最大的特点就是机会遍地，而现在这些机会正在消失，工薪阶层因此受困，所以将矛头对准了国家领导人，在这样一个时刻，解决方案迫在眉睫。

meaning: n. 历史学家，历史工作者
example: The historian spent ten years writing a comprehensive account of the Qing dynasty. 这位历史学家花了十年时间撰写一部关于清朝的综合性著作。

meaning: a. 实践的，实际的；实用的；注重实际的
example: Practically every week features at least one celebrity mom, or mom-to-be, smiling on the newsstands. (2011年Text 4) 实际上每周都会有至少一位明星妈妈或准妈妈微笑着出现在各种报纸的显要位置。

meaning: vt. 揭露，揭示；曝光；使接触，使体验
example: It's based on a somewhat fantasized, very white, very upper-middle-class ideology that says if you're failing to expose your child to 30,000 words you are neglecting them. (2017年英语二Text 2) 这是一种基于异想天开阶层的、中上层社会的白人化的理念，它认为如果在一日之内，你和孩子的交流未超过30000个词，你就是在忽视他们。

meaning: a. 有关的，有关主题的；有实际价值的，有实际重要性的
example: Make sure that all the information you provide in your resume is relevant to the job you are applying for. 确保你在简历中提供的所有信息都与所申请的职位相关。

meaning: n. 回答；反应
example: Women are particularly susceptible to developing depression and anxiety disorders in response to stress compared with men, according to Dr. Yehuda, chief psychiatrist at New York's Veteran's Administration Hospital. (2008年Text 1) 据纽约退伍军人管理医院的主任精神病学家Yehuda医生称，女性在面对压力时，比男性特别容易患抑郁症或焦虑症。

meaning: a. 明确的，确实的；一定的，肯定的
example: We need a definite answer before we can move forward with the project. 我们需要一个明确的答复才能继续推进这个项目。

meaning: vt. 描述，证明，论证；显示，演示；说明
example: Alvarez's experience demonstrates the importance of finding ways to diffuse stress before it threatens your health and your ability to function. (2008年Text 1) 阿尔瓦雷兹的经历说明了在压力影响到你的健康和生活能力之前寻求途径予以缓解是相当重要的。

meaning: n. 纪律，自制；训练，锻炼；惩罚；学科 vt. 训练；处罚
example: So when young people are critical of an over-tweeting president, they reveal a need for discipline in thinking skills—and in their choices on when to share on social media. (2018年Text 2) 因此，当年轻人批评推特上过度分享的总统时，他们表现出了一种自律的需求——不仅在社交媒体上分享信息时表现得有所节制。

meaning: n. 分析，研究；解析
example: Their reactions may be a complex combination of instant reflexes, input from past driving experiences, and what their eyes and ears tell them at that moment. (2019年Text 3) 他们的反应也许是瞬间反应的复杂组合，也包括参考过去驾驶经验，以及那一瞬间眼睛所见耳朵所闻。

meaning: ad. 再者；此外；而且
example: The plan is not practical; moreover, it would be far too expensive to carry out. 这个计划不切实际，此外，实施起来费用也太高。

meaning: a. 复杂的，合成的 n. 复合物；综合体
example: The issue is far more complex than it appears at first glance. 这个问题远没有乍一看那么简单。

meaning: a. 适当的；恰当的；合适的
example: Wearing casual clothes is appropriate for the informal gathering. 休闲聚会穿便装是合适的。

meaning: vt. 获得，取得；购得，习得
example: Online education can supplement the traditional kind. It could make extra training and instruction affordable. Professionals trying to acquire new skills will be able to do so without going into debt. (2018年Text 1) 在线教育可以作为传统教育的补充，可使额外训练和指导费用变得可负担得起，设法获得新技能的专业人员可以选择这种教育方式而不用负债。

meaning: n. (英国可出席上议院的)贵族；同辈；地位相同的人
example: Children look up to their peers for guidance on trends and behavior. 孩子们会从同辈那里获得关于潮流和行为的引导。

meaning: a. 竞争的，比赛的；有竞争力的；(指人)好竞争的
example: The job market has become increasingly competitive in recent years. 近年来，就业市场的竞争越来越激烈。

meaning: vt. 推荐，介绍；建议；(性质)使(某人，某物)有吸引力
example: What does national mean? Roy Romanow and Senator Michael Kirby recommended a federal-provincial body much like the recently created National Health Council. (2005年Part B) 『国家』意味着什么？罗伊·罗马诺和迈克尔·科尔比议员建议成立一个联邦政府和省政府一体的机构，就像最近成立的国家医疗委员会一样。

meaning: ad. 越来越多地；日益，格外，愈加
example: Neuroscientists, experts who study the nervous system, are increasingly showing that there's actually a lot that can be done. (2014年Use of English) 越来越多的神经科学家表示，实际上这种情况是可以改善的。

meaning: a. 特有的；独特的 n. 特性，特征，特色
example: With characteristic confidence, Dickens successfully insisted that Seymour's pictures illustrate his own story instead. (2019年Part B) 狄更斯以塑造人物形象十分有信心，坚持西摩的画描绘了他自己想象表达的故事。

meaning: vt. 赌博，打赌，投机 n. 碰运气，冒险
example: Investing all your savings in a single stock is a huge gamble. 把所有的积蓄都投资在单只股票上是巨大的冒险。

meaning: n. 地点；污点；发现 vt. 发现；弄污
example: It is one of the most beautiful spots on the entire coast. 这是整条海岸线上最美丽的地方之一。

meaning: a. 身体的，肉体的；物质的；有形的；物理学的
example: Regular physical exercise can greatly reduce the risk of chronic diseases. 规律的体育锻炼可以大大降低患慢性病的风险。

meaning: a. 实质上的，事实上的
example: Unfortunately, these critics are virtually forgotten. (2010年Text 1) 不幸的是，实际上这些批评家几乎被遗忘了。

meaning: a. 历史的，历史上的；有根据的
example: The novel is based on historical events that took place during World War II. 这部小说是以二战期间发生的历史事件为基础的。

meaning: n. 多数，大多数
example: Like the majority of authors, he had to suffer many disappointments and rejections along the way, but these made him all the more determined to succeed. (2019年英语二Translation) 与多数作家一样，詹姆斯·赫里奥特(James Herriot)不得不经受多次的失望与拒绝，但是这一切才坚定了它他追求成功的决心。

meaning: n. 大气层；空气；气氛，环境
example: The atmosphere in the meeting room became very tense after his announcement. 他宣布之后，会议室里的气氛变得非常紧张。

meaning: n. 途径；机会；权利；通道 v. 到达；进入；使用
example: But the ruling reinforces the need for citizens and their elected representatives, not the courts, to ensure equality of access to government. (2017年Text 4) 但是这个裁决强化了公民和他们选出的代表（而非法院）需要确保平等进入政府的必要性。

meaning: n. (尤指文学、艺术)评论家，批评家；吹毛求疵的人，爱挑剔者
example: In those far-off days, it was taken for granted that the critics of major papers would write in detail and at length about the events they covered. (2010年Text 1) 在那些过去的日子里，那些主要报纸的评论家们对他们报道的新闻自然是不惜笔墨，长篇大论。

meaning: v. 出版，刊登，登载；发表(自己的作品)；宣布，公布
example: But a comparative study of linguistic traits published online today supplies a reality check. (2012年Part C) 但是，今天在线发布的一项语言学特征的比较研究提供了一次核查现实的机会。

meaning: n. 选择，选拔；精选品，文选
example: The shop offers a wide selection of imported wines from around the world. 这家商店提供来自世界各地的丰富进口葡萄酒选择。

meaning: a. 起源的，遗传学的
example: Genetic research has made huge strides in the past two decades. 在过去二十年里，遗传学研究取得了巨大的进步。

meaning: v. (使)逐步发展，(使)逐渐演变
example: Curriculums—from grammar school to college—should evolve to focus less on memorizing facts and more on creativity and complex communication. (2018年Text 1) 课程——从语法学校课程到大学课程——都应该与时俱进，从关注记忆力转变为激发艺术文化和关注表达能力。
